integrity.claim_scope: finite-amplitude periodic-orbit barrier for the displayed three-species delay system
integrity.computational_dependence: none for the proof; an exact-arithmetic checker verifies algebraic rearrangements and the printed numerical threshold

scientific_limitations: The theorem is a necessary condition for strictly positive periodic solutions; it does not prove cycle existence, uniqueness, or stability.
For positive top-predator gestation delay, the proven finite-amplitude constraint is on the top-predator-weighted mean, not the ordinary time mean.

The Jensen mechanism is generic, so originality is asserted for the source-specific weighted barrier and its exact coincidence with this model's published invasion threshold, not for Jensen's inequality itself.
title: A delay-independent top-predator-weighted invasion barrier for positive cycles
